description: Edits an existing draft instead of creating a new one. Only the fields you pass change; the rest, including the thread it answers and its current attachments, stays. It is still NOT sent.

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

attachments.description: Paths of local files to add

keep_attachments.description: false drops the attachments the draft already has (default true)

name: update_draft
